integrity_statement: All mathematical statements are supported by a direct gap classification, rational generating-function derivation, and exact simplex-moment argument. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Linear binary words over the ordered alphabet 0<1 containing exactly three ones; not arbitrary composition or cyclic words.
The leading variance coefficient is proved asymptotically, not given as an exact finite-length variance formula.
Prior equivalent specializations may exist outside the sources inspected; historical priority is not certified.
Finite computations independently test but do not replace the all-length proof.
title: Three-marker binary Lyndon-factor census, isolated maximum, and fluctuation law
